753460.title: NRG gets its revenge, sweeps Nongshim RedForce
753460.author: jenopelle
summary: NRG opened Group D by beating the team that had stopped them in the Masters Santiago upper final. A 13–5 win on Lotus put them ahead, with mada recording 22 kills on the map.

On Split, mada’s Neon and keiko’s Raze gave NRG a fresh double-duelist look. Their 9–3 first half proved enough to withstand Nongshim’s recovery and close the map 13–10. mada finished the series with 34 kills as NRG moved one win away from playoffs.

753461.title: NRG progresses to playoffs with 2-1 over Karmine Corp
753461.author: raezeri
summary: Karmine Corp took Ascent 13–7, leaving NRG needing both remaining maps to secure a playoff spot. Ethan’s 1v3 pistol clutch helped build a lead on Summit, but KC fought back to 12–11. skuba’s last-round 1v2 stopped overtime and kept NRG in the series.

On Haven, repeated attacks through C turned an early deficit into a halftime lead. NRG closed the decider 13–9, with mada’s Neon delivering 23 kills, and finished Group D with a place in the top eight.

754732.title: NRG continues Champs form with T1 sweep
754732.author: jenopelle
summary: NRG started playoffs by taking T1’s Lotus pick 13–11. Summit was level at halftime after bonkar’s timeout helped NRG settle their defense. Their utility-heavy setup slowed T1 down before the sides switched.
NRG’s second-half attack pulled away, turning Summit into a 13–7 win. brawk led the match with 39 kills and a 1.46 rating. The sweep sent NRG into the upper semifinals and T1 into the lower bracket.
